summary: P0 refactor regression testing complete. server.py reduced from 5089 -> 2493 lines with 7 cohesive route modules extracted. 52/53 backend tests PASS (98%), 1 skipped due to stale data (legacy modelo_3d file missing from disk, NOT a refactor regression). All previously listed endpoints across both server.py (auth, proyectos, vuelos, avances, modelos3d chunked upload, estadisticas, notificaciones, preview) AND newly extracted routes (comparaciones, exportar, reporte_ejecutivo, solicitudes_vuelo, cronograma, maquinaria_ia, analisis_ia) are reachable, return correct status codes, and integrate properly. Chunked GridFS upload flow remains fully functional (11/11 tests pass).

minor.issue: Returns 500 (not 404) when underlying modelo file is missing on disk. Error message is correct ('El archivo puede no existir en el servidor') but should be 404. Pre-existing semantic issue, not a refactor regression.
Resend email service is in test mode — can only send to ianalejandrogn@gmail.com. Notification emails to admin@dron.mx fail silently. Pre-existing config issue, not a regression.
passlib bcrypt version detection warning ('module bcrypt has no attribute __about__'). Cosmetic, doesn't affect functionality.
